# GOG — accessing castle-recapture missions

- Original source: [Siege of Lincoln](https://www.gog.com/forum/robin_hood_legend_of_sherwood/siege_of_lincoln/post3)
- Author / publication: Turon1 and bamspeedy.224; GOG forum.
- Language / date: English; opened 2018-07-01.
- Access: Indexed opening and three replies inspected; thread marked solved.
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

Turon1 wants to replay recapture missions that successful defenses prevent from appearing. bamspeedy.224 describes allowing a defense countdown to expire while choosing another mission, and saving before mission completion to retry the next mission selection.

A follow-up reports that failing Lincoln’s defense eventually exposes Free Lincoln, followed by another defense, and that losing Derby leads back to The Black Castle. The player could not make Leicester’s defense fail and speculates about its campaign role. These are reported branch observations rather than a complete campaign-state specification; the explanation for Leicester remains conjectural.
